title: Standby
description: Swap between personas, which wait as player statues in the world.
body:
# Standby

Switch between personas and leave an avatar waiting at each one's last location.
When you swap, your previous persona stays standing exactly where you left — ready for you to return.

---

<!-- GIF: switching from default to an alias — skin changes, player teleports to the statue location -->

![Switching standbys.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a00e6fc9cc19b99b44e7c943be63ad1edcb312b3.gif)
---

## How it works

Register a persona with `/standby new <name>`. When you switch to it, your skin changes and you're teleported to where that persona last stood. When you leave, a statue of them is placed at your position.

Your real identity is never lost — `/standby off` always brings you back.

---
![Many standbys.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95a7dc0b1ef920bacb21faa53493d5767d0b5cc7.png)
<!-- IMAGE: side-by-side of two personas standing in different locations in a base -->

---

## Controls

| Action | Keybind | Command |
|---|---|---|
| Next persona | `.` | `/standby next` |
| Previous persona | `,` | `/standby previous` |
| Return to self | `;` | `/standby off` |
| Switch directly | — | `/standby set <name>` |
| New persona | — | `/standby new <name>` |
| Remove persona | — | `/standby delete <name>` |
| List all | — | `/standby list` |

Works in **survival**, on **servers**, without **OP**.

---
![Cycling through many standbys.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d13a8b06e4de40e77dbf78dd65c894c4028eaae8.gif)

## Requirements

- [SkinShifter](https://modrinth.com/mod/skinshifter)
- [Player Armor Stands](https://modrinth.com/mod/player-armor-stands)
